concerns.text: FR-001 mandates downloading from NIST Chemistry WebBook and Materials Project APIs. The plan explicitly states: 'NIST/Materials Project APIs are excluded due to lack of verified URLs' and instead uses HuggingFace datasets. This is a direct violation of the functional requirement; the plan does not address the mandated data source.

FR-008 requires the system to 'halt and report a fatal error' if ALL records fail validation (missing labels). The plan states: 'If ALL records are flagged, halt with a fatal error (FR-008)' in the research doc, but the plan.md itself does not define the task or logic for this fatal halt condition, only the research doc mentions it. The plan must explicitly include the logic to halt execution if the dataset is empty after filtering.

SC-004 requires a power analysis warning if n<150. The plan mentions 'Power Analysis Execution' (T017b) in the comments block, but the plan.md text itself does not explicitly describe the task or phase where this power analysis is performed and the warning is triggered. It is only implied in the 'Research' doc. The plan must explicitly map the power analysis task to the SC-004 requirement.

SC-005 requires verifying ester bonds in top attribution scores for ≥90% of hydrolysis cases. The plan mentions 'Ester Attribution Validation' (T030) in the comments, but the plan.md text does not explicitly describe the validation logic or the 90% threshold check. The plan must explicitly state how this specific success criterion is measured and validated.

SC-006 targets a ≥95% success rate for data ingestion. The plan mentions 'Data Integrity Check' (T019) but does not explicitly state that this check includes calculating the success rate and verifying it meets the ≥95% threshold. The plan must explicitly link the integrity check to this specific metric.

SC-008 requires measuring the percentage of low-confidence predictions correctly flagged. The plan mentions 'Confidence Flagging' in the research doc but does not explicitly describe a task or phase in the plan.md that measures this percentage and reports it. The plan must explicitly include the measurement of this success criterion.

SC-010 requires measuring the ratio of flagged/excluded records. The plan mentions 'Identify records missing labels' (T014) but does not explicitly state that the output of this task includes calculating and reporting the ratio of flagged records to total records. The plan must explicitly link the labeling task to this metric.

SC-011 requires the presence of a valid p-value from the χ² test in the report. The plan mentions 'Statistical Validation' (T037) but does not explicitly state that the report generation task includes verifying the presence of the p-value. The plan must explicitly link the validation task to this output requirement.

SC-012 requires the successful creation of a report containing top motifs. The plan mentions 'Generate final report' (T037) but does not explicitly state that the report must contain at least 3 distinct motifs as per SC-007 and SC-012. The plan must explicitly include the content requirements for the final report.

FR-004 requires expanding the training set by 'exactly 2x'. The plan mentions 'Data augmentation (2x)' in the complexity tracking but does not explicitly describe the task or logic to ensure the expansion is exactly 2x, not just 'approximately'. The plan must explicitly state the exact 2x expansion requirement.

FR-009 requires switching to leave-one-out (LOO) validation if n<150. The plan mentions '5-fold CV (or LOO if n<150)' in the research doc but does not explicitly describe the task or logic in the plan.md that triggers this switch. The plan must explicitly include the logic for switching to LOO.

FR-009 requires skipping invalid SMILES strings without crashing. The plan mentions 'Invalid SMILES' in the troubleshooting section but does not explicitly describe the task or logic in the plan.md that handles this. The plan must explicitly include the error handling for invalid SMILES.

FR-009 requires exponential backoff with a maximum of 3 retries. The plan mentions 'API rate limits' in the troubleshooting section but does not explicitly describe the task or logic in the plan.md that implements this backoff. The plan must explicitly include the backoff logic.

SC-003 requires measuring computational feasibility against CI runner constraints (≤6h runtime, ~7GB RAM). The plan mentions 'Compute Feasibility' in the research doc but does not explicitly describe a task or phase in the plan.md that measures and reports these metrics. The plan must explicitly include the measurement of these constraints.

SC-009 requires measuring data augmentation runtime against a predefined time limit. The plan mentions 'Data augmentation (2x) within 30 minutes' in the complexity tracking but does not explicitly describe a task or phase in the plan.md that measures and reports this runtime. The plan must explicitly include the measurement of the augmentation runtime.

FR-006 requires a χ² test with ≥1000 iterations. The plan mentions 'χ² test with 1000 iterations' in the complexity tracking but does not explicitly describe the task or logic in the plan.md that ensures this specific number of iterations. The plan must explicitly include the iteration count requirement.

FR-007 requires generating a final report listing top structural motifs. The plan mentions 'Generate final report' (T037) but does not explicitly state that the report must list the top motifs. The plan must explicitly include the content requirements for the final report.

FR-005 requires computing feature importance scores using Integrated Gradients. The plan mentions 'Integrated Gradients' in the research doc but does not explicitly describe the task or logic in the plan.md that computes these scores. The plan must explicitly include the Integrated Gradients computation task.

FR-003 requires a lightweight GNN with ≤3 layers and hidden dim ≤128. The plan mentions 'Lightweight GNN (≤3 layers, hidden dim ≤128)' in the summary but does not explicitly describe the task or logic in the plan.md that implements this specific architecture. The plan must explicitly include the GNN architecture implementation task.

FR-002 requires converting SMILES to molecular graphs and handling missing values. The plan mentions 'SMILES → Graph' in the project structure but does not explicitly describe the task or logic in the plan.md that handles missing values. The plan must explicitly include the missing value handling task.

FR-001 requires filtering specifically for polyesters. The plan mentions 'Filter: Retain only polyester records' in the research doc but does not explicitly describe the task or logic in the plan.md that performs this filtering. The plan must explicitly include the polyester filtering task.

FR-001 requires applying a synthetic label distribution if labels are missing. The plan mentions 'Apply synthetic label distribution' in the research doc but does not explicitly describe the task or logic in the plan.md that applies this distribution. The plan must explicitly include the synthetic label application task.

FR-001 requires flagging records for manual curation if labels are missing. The plan mentions 'Flag records for manual curation' in the research doc but does not explicitly describe the task or logic in the plan.md that flags these records. The plan must explicitly include the record flagging task.

FR-001 requires downloading records from NIST and Materials Project. The plan explicitly excludes these APIs. This is a critical unbacked requirement. The plan must either implement the API download or explicitly state why it is not possible and propose an alternative that satisfies the requirement's intent (which is not currently done).

SC-001 requires measuring prediction performance against held-out test set and mean cross-validation folds. The plan mentions '5-fold cross-validation' in the research doc but does not explicitly describe a task or phase in the plan.md that measures and reports these metrics. The plan must explicitly include the performance measurement task.

SC-002 requires measuring statistical significance against a null distribution. The plan mentions 'χ² test' in the research doc but does not explicitly describe a task or phase in the plan.md that measures and reports this significance. The plan must explicitly include the statistical significance measurement task.

SC-007 requires the motif report to contain at least 3 distinct structural motifs. The plan mentions 'Generate final report' (T037) but does not explicitly state that the report must contain at least 3 distinct motifs. The plan must explicitly include the motif count requirement in the report generation task.
